standard.description: Case base demand and prices; deterministic planned deliveries; reliability is not multiplied into supply.

mandatory_stress.description: +15% demand in 2038-2040; +25% A/B variable prices in 2038-2039; ISRU actual delivery factors 55%/75%/100%; storage loss rate must be <=2% from 2038.

low_demand.description: Low demand series from case input; critical demand keeps the base-year critical share.

high_demand.description: High demand series from case input; critical demand keeps the base-year critical share.
